note: Re-judged 2026-11-02 by an independent auditor who authored none of 9d7957d61f, 5296340831, 982500f728 or b803afc762. RFC 7947 Section 2.2.2.2 read: "If the route server client BGP system has implemented a check for this, the BGP implementation MUST allow this check to be disabled and SHOULD allow the check to be disabled on a per-peer basis." Ze implements the check in Session.firstASMismatch and prepareRFC7606FirstAS (reactor/session_validation.go, session_validation_receive.go); both gate on Session.firstASPeer, which turns it off when this session's own OPEN carries Role RS-client (localRSClient, session_negotiate.go), a per-peer setting. The tags now sit on reactor/rfc7947_session_first_as_test.go::TestSessionASPAFirstASRoles, which drives the real session read path over net.Pipe (OPEN, KEEPALIVE, UPDATE through ReadAndProcess) and captures the semantic UPDATE at the message callback. Positive: local Role RS-client with remote Role RS or no Role (loose); an UPDATE from AS 65002 with AS_PATH [65003] arrives byte-identical, session stays Established. Negative: local Role RS or no Role, remote Role RS or not; the same UPDATE arrives as exactly the withdrawal of 203.0.113.0/24, so the check stays on for every peer the exemption does not name (per peer). Isolation: a single AS_SEQUENCE whose only fault is the leftmost AS; local AS 65001 is absent, so no loop rule can fire. Discrimination: two mutant records on firstASPeer line 340 (drop && !s.localRSClient turns the positive red; force the check off turns the negative red). The LoopIngress tags judged weak before were removed in b803afc762. Not covered here: the config path from a peer's role leaf to the transmitted Role capability, which this unit sets through the plugin capability getter. Verdict: enforced (was weak; the tagged units changed).
